note.ja: [0,2π)²周期、t=0.5、16/32/64格子のMAC圧力射影。保存すべき定数エネルギーではなく粘性減衰を調べる。空間と安定刻みの同時細分化と、同一格子の刻み感度を区別する。
note.en: Periodic [0,2π)², t=0.5, MAC pressure projection on 16/32/64 grids. Check viscous decay rather than constant energy. Combined space/stable-step refinement is separated from fixed-grid time-step sensitivity.

references.formula: (u,v)=(sin x cos y,−cos x sin y)e^(−2νt); p=(cos 2x+cos 2y)e^(−4νt)/4

assumptions.en: Periodic [0,2π]²; unit density; viscosity 0.1; zero mean pressure. Web profile is an x-slice at y=π/4.

note.ja: 同じν=0.1・周期[0,2π]²の解析モデルですが、参照カードはy=π/4のx断面表示です。2次元速度・圧力場や格子誤差の配列とは一致しません。
note.en: The analytic model shares ν=0.1 and periodic [0,2π]², but the card displays an x-slice at y=π/4, not full 2D velocity/pressure or mesh-error arrays.

reference_note.en: Check analytic 2D periodic Taylor–Green velocity/pressure, viscous decay and discrete divergence. The library display is a y=π/4 slice rather than the full 2D computed field.

name.ja: 周期Taylor–Green渦：速度・散逸・発散
name.en: Periodic Taylor–Green vortex: velocity, decay and divergence

scope.ja: 既存の2次元MAC投影法・中心対流項・明示SSPRK2を使用。16²/32²/64²で解析的減衰渦と比較し、最細格子はCFL半減でも確認。
scope.en: Use existing two-dimensional MAC projection, centered convection and explicit SSPRK2. Compare analytic decaying vortex on 16²/32²/64² grids and halve CFL on the finest grid.

assumptions.ja: 単位密度、[0,2π)²、ν=0.1、T=0.5。u₀=sin x cos y、v₀=−cos x sin y。既存ソルバーの移流・拡散安定性に基づくCFL=0.2、時間感度検査は0.1。
assumptions.en: Unit density, [0,2*pi)², nu=0.1 and T=0.5. u0=sin(x)cos(y), v0=-cos(x)sin(y). CFL=0.2 uses the solver's combined advection/diffusion stability estimate; temporal sensitivity uses 0.1.

limits.ja: 非正粘性・終端時刻、CFL範囲外、倍増でない格子を拒否。安定時間刻みも変わる格子細分化は空間のみの次数証明ではない。固定格子のCFL半減は時間感度であり厳密誤差上界ではない。壁境界・乱流・任意Reynolds数への検証ではない。
limits.en: Reject nonpositive viscosity/final time, invalid CFL and nondoubling grids. Grid refinement also changes the stable time step and is not a pure spatial-order proof. Fixed-grid CFL reduction measures sensitivity, not a rigorous error bound. No validation of walls, turbulence or arbitrary Reynolds number.

reference_note.ja: CSVは(i,j)をC順に並べ、u面・v面・圧力中心それぞれの座標、数値解と解析解を別列に保存。MAC速度を同じ位置の成分と誤解しない。JSONにエネルギー履歴と時間感度を保存。
reference_note.en: CSV uses C-order (i,j) rows with separate coordinates and numerical/analytic values for u faces, v faces and pressure centers; the components are not collocated. JSON includes energy histories and temporal sensitivity.

description.ja: u=sin x cos y e^(−2νt)、v=−cos x sin y e^(−2νt)、p=(cos2x+cos2y)e^(−4νt)/4。平均運動エネルギーはe^(−4νt)/4。
description.en: u=sin(x)cos(y)e^(-2nu*t), v=-cos(x)sin(y)e^(-2nu*t), p=(cos(2x)+cos(2y))e^(-4nu*t)/4; mean kinetic energy e^(-4nu*t)/4.
